items.title: Senate agrees to second reading of the Securing the NDIS for Future Generations Bill

source.title: Bill homepage: NDIS Amendment (Securing the NDIS for Future Generations) Bill 2026

items.summary: The Senate agreed to the second reading and began Committee of the Whole debate on 18 August 2026. The bill's listed status remains "Before Senate".

items.title: Securing the NDIS for Future Generations Bill passes the Senate third reading
items.summary: The Senate agreed to the third reading on 18 August 2026, after agreeing to 32 government amendments in Committee of the Whole. The amended bill requires House agreement before assent.

source.title: Bill homepage: NDIS Amendment (Securing the NDIS for Future Generations) Bill 2026

items.title: NDIS banning orders ramp up as record number of shonks kicked off scheme
items.summary: The media release states the NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission issued 111 banning orders to individuals, registered providers and unregistered providers between April and June 2026.

source.title: Media release, Minister for the NDIS
source.publisher: Department of Health, Disability and Ageing

items.title: Senate Community Affairs Legislation Committee final report on the Securing the NDIS for Future Generations Bill
items.summary: The committee's final report, tabled 14 August 2026, recommends that the bill be passed.

source.title: Report — NDIS Amendment (Securing the NDIS for Future Generations) Bill 2026 inquiry

items.title: NDIA publishes June 2026 quarter payments, participant and utilisation datasets
items.summary: Quarterly CSV datasets covering payments, participant numbers and plan budgets, and plan budget utilisation were published. The payments page states data current as at 30 June 2026.

source.title: Payments datasets

items.title: Quarterly Report to Disability Ministers, Q4 2025-26, supplement published
items.summary: The supplement to the quarterly report to disability ministers for the fourth quarter of 2025-26 was published, together with state, territory and topic appendices.

source.title: Quarterly report supplements

items.title: Senate Community Affairs public hearing in Perth on the Securing the NDIS for Future Generations Bill
items.summary: The Community Affairs Legislation Committee held a public hearing in Perth as part of its inquiry into the bill, following hearings in Melbourne and Canberra in June and July 2026.

source.title: Public hearings — Securing the NDIS for Future Generations Bill inquiry

items.title: Technical experts to guide fairer, more consistent NDIS access
items.summary: A Technical Advisory Group met for the first time to provide independent advice on assessing substantially reduced functional capacity, which guides access to the NDIS.

source.title: Media release, Minister for Disability and the NDIS
source.publisher: Department of Health, Disability and Ageing

items.title: NDIS Support Catalogue 2026-27 v1.1 published
items.summary: The 2026-27 Support Catalogue (976 current support items, current as of 3 July 2026) replaces the eight state and territory price-limit columns with a single national price column.

source.title: NDIS Support Catalogue 2026-27 v1.1 (XLSX)

items.title: Securing the NDIS for Future Generations Bill passes the House of Representatives
items.summary: The House agreed to the third reading on 2 July 2026, following consideration in detail on 1 July at which 12 crossbench and 18 government amendments were agreed to.

source.title: Bill homepage: NDIS Amendment (Securing the NDIS for Future Generations) Bill 2026

items.title: Old Framework Plans (Pricing Documents) Determination 2026 registered
items.summary: The determination replaces references to "Pricing Arrangements and Price Limits" with "Pricing Schedule" and substitutes "priced" for "price-limited". It commences on the later of 1 July 2026 and the day after registration.

source.title: F2026L00906 — NDIS Amendment (Old Framework Plans) (Pricing Documents) Determination 2026

items.title: Crackdown on sales of NDIS businesses as mandatory registration set to expand from 1 July
items.summary: Amended NDIS rules require providers to notify as soon as they become aware a sale will occur, and require new audits where there are significant changes to governance or operations.

source.title: Media release, Minister for the NDIS
source.publisher: Department of Health, Disability and Ageing

items.title: Provider Registration and Practice Standards Amendment (Mandatory Registration and Other Matters) Rules 2026 registered
items.summary: Rules made under the National Disability Insurance Scheme Act 2013, administered by the Department of Health, Disability and Ageing, were registered on 24 June 2026.

source.title: F2026L00802 — NDIS (Provider Registration and Practice Standards) Amendment (Mandatory Registration and Other Matters) Rules 2026

items.title: Senate Community Affairs Legislation Committee interim report on the Securing the NDIS for Future Generations Bill
items.summary: The interim report recommends the Department of Health, Disability and Ageing table a roadmap setting out timelines and consultation requirements, and that the explanatory memorandum add further clarification.

source.title: Interim Report — Securing the NDIS for Future Generations Bill inquiry

items.title: Quarterly Report to Disability Ministers, Q3 2025-26, supplement published
items.summary: The supplement for the third quarter of 2025-26 was published with the state and territory comparison, national and specialist disability accommodation appendices.

source.title: Quarterly report supplements

items.summary: Budget estimates hearings ran from 2 to 5 June 2026. The Community Affairs committees cover the Health, Disability and Ageing and Social Services portfolios.

source.title: Senate estimates — Community Affairs

items.title: NDIA publishes March 2026 quarter payments dataset
items.summary: The quarterly payments CSV covering the March 2026 quarter was published on the NDIS data and research site.

source.title: Payments datasets

items.title: Securing the NDIS for Future Generations Bill introduced and referred to committee
items.summary: Introduced in the House of Representatives on 14 May 2026 and referred the same day to the Senate Community Affairs Legislation Committee. Portfolio: Health, Disability and Ageing.

source.title: Bill homepage: NDIS Amendment (Securing the NDIS for Future Generations) Bill 2026

items.title: Securing the future of the NDIS for future generations
items.summary: The government announced next steps to restore the NDIS to its original intent of supporting people with permanent and significant disability, ahead of introducing amending legislation.

source.title: Media release, Minister for Disability and the NDIS
source.publisher: Department of Health, Disability and Ageing

items.title: NDIS Amendment (Integrity and Safeguarding) Act 2026 registered
items.summary: Act No. 41 of 2026 was registered on the Federal Register of Legislation on 10 April 2026, following Royal Assent on 8 April 2026. Administered by Health, Disability and Ageing.

source.title: C2026A00041 — NDIS Amendment (Integrity and Safeguarding) Act 2026

items.title: Regulator welcomes new powers to strengthen NDIS integrity and safeguards
items.summary: The NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission said the passed reforms deliver tougher penalties for serious misconduct and unsafe practices and stronger powers for the regulator.

source.title: Media release, NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission

items.title: NDIS Amendment (Integrity and Safeguarding) Bill passes both houses
items.summary: The House of Representatives agreed to the third reading on 1 April 2026, after the Senate passed the bill on 31 March 2026. The bill finally passed both houses that day.

source.title: Bill homepage: NDIS Amendment (Integrity and Safeguarding) Bill 2026

items.title: Senate Community Affairs Legislation Committee reports on the Integrity and Safeguarding Bill
items.summary: The committee reported on 20 March 2026 on the bill referred to it on 27 November 2025, having held a public hearing in Canberra on 24 February 2026.

source.title: NDIS Amendment (Integrity and Safeguarding) Bill 2025 inquiry

items.title: Therapy pilot to inform pricing reforms
items.summary: A $20 million, 12-month NDIS Quality Supports Program Therapy Pilot will collect data from 27 registered providers on service delivery, workforce skills and participant outcomes to inform how therapies are priced.

source.title: Media release, Minister for the NDIS
source.publisher: Department of Health, Disability and Ageing

items.title: Joint Standing Committee on the NDIS begins Annual Report No. 2 inquiry
items.summary: The inquiry for Annual Report No. 2 of the 48th Parliament was referred on 11 March 2026. It includes examination of the annual reports of the NDIA and the NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission.

source.title: Joint Standing Committee on the National Disability Insurance Scheme

items.summary: Additional estimates hearings were held on 11 and 12 February 2026. The Community Affairs committees cover the Health, Disability and Ageing and Social Services portfolios.

source.title: Senate estimates — Community Affairs

items.title: Advice on national model for Thriving Kids
items.summary: The government released the Thriving Kids Advisory Group's report, which recommends supporting children aged under nine with developmental delay or autism and low to moderate support needs outside the NDIS.

source.title: Media release, Minister for Disability and the NDIS
source.publisher: Department of Health, Disability and Ageing

items.title: Mandatory registration for Supported Independent Living and platform providers to start from next year
items.summary: The government announced that mandatory registration with the NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission for Supported Independent Living providers and platform providers will begin from 1 July 2026.

source.title: Media release, NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission

items.title: Record $2.5 million penalty imposed on NDIS provider for failing to keep participants safe
items.summary: The Federal Court imposed a $2.5 million penalty on Lifestyle Solutions (Aust) Pty Ltd, described as the highest penalty imposed in proceedings brought by the NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission.

source.title: Media release, NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission

items.title: ANAO Report No. 2 of 2025-26: Effectiveness of the NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission's Regulatory Functions
items.summary: The audit concluded the NDIS Commission is partly effective in exercising its regulatory functions. It made 10 recommendations; the Commission agreed to nine and agreed in principle to one.

source.title: Auditor-General Report No. 2 of 2025-26

items.title: Thriving Kids — a new program to support children with developmental delay and autism, and their families
items.summary: The government announced a commitment of $2 billion over five years from 1 July 2026 for a national system of supports for children aged eight and under with mild to moderate developmental delay and autism.

source.title: News item, Department of Health, Disability and Ageing
source.publisher: Department of Health, Disability and Ageing

items.title: ANAO Report No. 48 of 2024-25: NDIA's Management of Claimant Compliance with NDIS Claim Requirements
items.summary: The audit found the NDIA's management of NDIS claim compliance is partly effective. Four recommendations were made and the NDIA agreed to all four.

source.title: Auditor-General Report No. 48 of 2024-25

items.title: ANAO Report No. 41 of 2024-25: Effectiveness of the Board of the National Disability Insurance Agency
items.summary: The audit found the governance of the NDIA Board was largely effective, with partly fit-for-purpose arrangements to oversee operations. Three recommendations were made and the NDIA agreed to all three.

source.title: Auditor-General Report No. 41 of 2024-25
